title: Pisa Particle Physics Journal Club
tagline: A weekly informal meeting to discuss new papers in particle physics, cosmology and related fields.

agenda.title: Talk
agenda.detail: One participant presents a paper or a topic.

agenda.title: Papers of the week
agenda.detail: Quick discussion of the selected arXiv papers.

about: The journal club is open to students, postdocs and staff interested in high-energy physics, astroparticle physics and cosmology.

Each weekday a short digest of new arXiv papers is posted here; vote on the ones worth discussing. Every Monday a balanced selection, favouring the most voted, becomes the programme for Tuesday. Speakers are drawn at the end of each session for the following week.
